ns2:course.label: Advanced Price Analysis
ns2:course.description: Study of methods used to analyze factors affecting agricultural prices; analysis of agricultural prices and price movements with respect to time, space, and form; and examination of methods of price forecasting and techniques of time series analysis. Prerequisite: ACE 562 or ECON 507 and ECON 500; or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ACE 562 or ECON 507 and ECON 500; or equivalent.
